about: Group challenge templates. Curated only: no free-text goals, nothing about medications, fasting or weight. proof 'scans' is counted from the player's own scans; 'checkin' from a daily yes/no the whole group can see. minToPlacePct is the share of the maximum points a player needs before they can place.

templates.title: Scan before you order
templates.blurb: Check at least one menu or product every day.

templates.title: Scan every meal out
templates.blurb: A point for every scan, up to three a day.

templates.title: No added sugar
templates.blurb: Check in each day you skipped added sugar.

templates.title: Stay under your salt limit
templates.blurb: Check in each day you kept to your sodium limit.

templates.title: Cook at home
templates.blurb: Check in each day you cooked a meal yourself.
